Resolves #19361

🌿 An edge announced into a hidden grid is no longer an edge the operator has already been told about.

`Neo.grid.Body` clears its `scrollEdge` latch when it mounts. A store load reaching an unmounted body still runs the window calculator with the geometry it last measured, so a window landing behind a hidden grid announced the new count and latched it; the body shown again at that count announced nothing, and the viewport stood at an edge the engine believed it had reported. The announcement itself is not gated on `mounted` — the spec's bodies, and every unit arm downstream, drive unmounted bodies.

Change class: behavior — one re-arm on mount; payload, predicate and the count key are unchanged.
agent-preflight: not hosted here; the archaeology guard and the grid unit folder ran locally; CI follows.

Evidence: L2 (the owning unit spec, red-first against `dev`'s body) → L2 required. The browser-side path is the Institution's: the memories pane's replay (`summaryEdgeDeferred`, neomjs/neo-agent-institution#434) is the consumer witness that found it, and retires with a pin carrying this.
